ios.desc:
Rossino is a free pomodoro timer for Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Everything below is included at no charge unless it is marked (Pro). Rossino Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription, purchased in the app, that connects the timer across your devices: start a focus session at your desk, pick up your phone, and the countdown reads the same second on both.

THE TIMER
• Classic pomodoro flow: 25 minutes of focus, a 5-minute break, and a long break every fourth session. Every duration and the cycle length can be changed.
• When a session ends, a chime plays and Rossino asks what comes next: start the break, start another focus session, or stop. It never steals your keyboard. Auto-start is available in Settings if you would rather not be asked.
• The cycle row shows your day at a glance: red tomatoes for focus, green for breaks. Solid means finished, hollow means skipped, dimmed means not yet reached. It resets each morning.
• A notification with sound at every phase change, with Start, Pause, and Skip actions right on the notification.

EVERYWHERE YOU GLANCE
• Mac: a countdown in the menu bar, always visible, plus full keyboard and menu control.
• iPhone: a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, StandBy, a Control Center toggle, and Home Screen quick actions.
• iPhone Duo: folded, the full timer on the outer display; opened in landscape, the timer and your week's chart side by side.
• Widgets in every size on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, including Lock Screen accessories and Apple Watch complications.

STATISTICS
• Today's sessions, focused minutes, breaks taken, and your streak.
• A 7-day chart on Mac, iPhone, and iPad.
• Statistics sync between your devices for free, so your history follows you to a new device.

ROSSINO PRO (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION, PURCHASED IN THE APP)
The free app is a complete timer for one device, and your statistics already sync. Pro adds two things, and only these two require a purchase:
• Live timer sync (Pro). Start, pause, or skip on one device, and the others follow, to the second. Without Pro, a second device shows what is running elsewhere but cannot join in.
• Full history (Pro): charts and trends beyond the last 7 days.

Pro is one subscription that covers Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch: $3.99 per month, or $24.99 per year with a 7-day free trial.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no account to create and no tracking of any kind. Rossino contains no ads and no analytics. Your timer and history live on yo
